name: dsfd_vm_fcn_m5_xgos-x1-COMMIT
purpose: DEFAULT-OFF VM-read optimized variant (owner 10-14: parallel, replaces the current fcn only if it closes): the closed sumpipe fcn (TT +76.85 / FF +21.00) + XGOS (OT_SPVM_XGOS): an XGO armed on its producer slot starts when the slot completes, so the controller issues the consumer stream together with the ARMN. Measured (s81_vm_gate, production tp shape + 128-row dependent stream): ARMN -> first X row at the bank 104 -> 89 (flat) / 107 -> 91 (hierarchy lockstep 0 mismatches); the die-level saving also removes the VM -> controller done path and the controller -> VM command path (hub stages). Source extracted by tools/s81_vm/extract_fe_leaf.py (receipt physical/s81_fe_fcn_xgos/source_receipt.json); pins / outline / clocks identical to sumpipe.

structural_change: XGOS slot-armed X streamer start (5 wait flags, 5 slot ids, 4 fresh-completion flags, 5 release flops; ad_r holds a second XGO on a waiting streamer) on top of the closed sumpipe fcn; no port, clock or outline change.
